changelog: Improve DeepSeek Harness, DSH GUI, OCR, scanned PDF, CJK, PDF-to-Markdown, tables, formulas, endpoint, credential, and troubleshooting discovery.
summary: Install and configure the native PaddleOCR plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH) from the Settings → PaddleOCR GUI. Use for OCR and image-to-text from screenshots, scans, and PDFs; Chinese/CJK text; PDF-to-Markdown; structured document parsing with tables, formulas, layout, and reading order; or DSH endpoint, credential, GUI setup, verification, and troubleshooting.
